prompt: Create a landscape 1440x1000 high-fidelity desktop web application home screen comp for the internal Showoff Admin Portal, shown after a successful server-side platform_admin check. It must be a real interface, not a poster. This option's direction is Run of Show: a disciplined production cue sheet, numbered operational sections, structured ruled rows, one restrained signal-red attention color; do not make it theatrical. Warm stock #f2eee5, ink navy #192534, red #b53d31, slate #5b7588. Composition: a narrow dark vertical operator rail at left with text links OVERVIEW, TENANTS, SUPPORT, PROVIDER HEALTH, SETTINGS. Main content has a small label SHOWOFF ADMIN, title OVERVIEW, and three broad sequential cue-sheet sections numbered 01 TENANTS, 02 SUPPORT, 03 PROVIDER HEALTH. Inside each section, show no fabricated rows, counts, names, incidents, health scores, usage or status values. Instead use one legible outlined neutral state reading UNAVAILABLE and the reason No operational data is connected yet. Distinguish the unavailable state with text plus a quiet outlined symbol, not color alone. Include a compact top-right neutral status DATA CONNECTIONS / NOT CONNECTED. Clearly keep navigation and reading order; allow rows to stack on small screens. Visible text must be limited to: SHOWOFF ADMIN, OVERVIEW, TENANTS, SUPPORT, PROVIDER HEALTH, SETTINGS, 01, 02, 03, DATA CONNECTIONS, NOT CONNECTED, UNAVAILABLE, No operational data is connected yet. No other words, IDs, timestamps, statistics, customer or provider names, claims, graphs, decorative metric marks, or fake data. Crisp readable operational screen, restrained paper cue sheet grammar, clear negative space. The UI is the subject.
